top_signals.title: Chancellor announces Bank of England appointments
top_signals.summary: His Majesty the King and the Chancellor have appointed three new non-executive directors to the Bank of England’s Court of Directors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Labour warned UK at risk of foreign tech giants ‘pulling the plug’
top_signals.summary: Labour has “no plan” if foreign technology companies or governments cut Britain off from systems underpinning critical services, the Liberal Democrats have warned, after ministers acknowledged the risks posed by the UK’s reliance on overseas tech. Victoria Collins, the Lib Dems’ tech spokesperson, accused the government of handing “contract after contract to foreign tech oligarchs” [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: US Air Force has a $14 billion supply hole, service officials say
top_signals.summary: As the force grapples with supply chain and maintenance issues, sustainment funding to fill the $14 billion gap is becoming increasingly necessary.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Air Force to extend service of B-1, B-2 bombers, official says
top_signals.summary: The service lives of the B-1 Lancer and B-2 Spirit will be extended, with their pilots to be some of the first to fly the B-21 Raider.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nations take action on North Korean IT workers after UN report
top_signals.summary: A report published Wednesday said that as of July, Vietnam, Laos, Pakistan and Argentina took meaningful steps to respond to allegations involving North Korea listed in an October study.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
